versions.changelog: v2.3 quality enhancement - security audit + marketing packaging + slug-content validation

Initial release of AgentCore 免费版 – a basic smart agent deployment helper built on AWS Bedrock AgentCore Runtime and LangGraph.

- Supports single-agent StateGraph definition, tool routing with tools_condition, and basic containerized deployment.
- Provides HTTP service on port 8080 with /invocations and /ping endpoints.
- Includes agent memory (STM only, no LTM) and example CLI/dev workflow.
- Does not support multi-agent orchestration, Gateway tool integration, or cross-session long-term memory.
- Recommended for quick prototyping and local development; upgrade to paid version for advanced features.
